tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: All the documents must be attested, scanned and uploaded.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The contractor should neither make any alteration in the conditions of contract or not stipulate any conditions of his own

The 2nd Electronic tender document i.e., Financial bid of all the participated bidder will be opened after approval of the technical bid qualification among eligible bidders the lowest bidder will be identified. If the lowest bidder fails to produce the original documents for entering into an agreement or the original documents submitted does not match with the uploaded documents or found false, then his bid is treated as non-responsive bid as per clause-26(4) of the KTPP rules & his name would be recommended for the removal from the select list of KPWD enrolment and barred from participation in any of the tenders invited by the KNNL apart from forfeiting the EMD paid through e-cash
Evaluation will be done based on the information provided by the contractor as per the document uploaded through e-procurement the correctness of the uploaded document will be verified if necessary.

Any bidders who is otherwise technically qualified withdraws from the bidding process at any stage before a final decisions taken on the tender, the EMD of such bidder shall be forfeited, the name of such bidder shall be recommended for removal from the KPWD contractors at least for a minimum period of one year in KNNL, besides making such bidders liable for black listing.

Any of the bidder who withdraws from the bidding process after completion of tender submission date at any stage before a final decision taken on the tender, the EMD of such bidder shall be forfeited and the name of such bidder shall be removed from the select list of KPWD registration and barred from participation in any of the tenders invited by KNNL thereafter

GST: The tenderer should quote the rate with respect to the amount shown as work portion in Column No-3 of Statement showing the details of work under Invitation For Tenders (IFT). As per Govt. order GST will be paid separately as per the prevailing rates as applicable under laws subject to the conditions mentioned in the Govt. circular No. FD 417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09-08-2024. G.S.T will be paid at 18% or applicable rates at the time of payment of RA Bills, subject to verification
The bidders shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-procurement on or before the last date of bid submission (Through Electronic Media)

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The department shall not be responsible for non- accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches

Even though the agency/firm meets the qualifying criteria, they are subjected to disqualification if they have made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and incomplete filling of details in the prequalification document.

The evaluation of pre-qualification will be done based on the information provided by the contractor as per the documents uploaded through e-procurement. The correctness of the uploaded documents will be verified if necessary.
Conditional tenders will be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tender without assigning any reason whatsoever
Taxes will be deducted at the prevailing rates
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before attending and also submitting their tenders.
Karnataka Neeravari Nigam Ltd., Reserves the right to verify the correctness of the statements and documents furnished and inspect the jobs executed by the agency/firm, if found necessary.
The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document of KC-8
All relevant documents as per the KNNL need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in e-procurement portal
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act
Bidders should not be under any declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and Fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Scanned Signature of the Bidder/Authorized Representative incase of firm/company to be attached while uploading bid documents along with valid power of attorney
The officer competent to accept the tenders shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason and whatsoever.
The Contractor should adhere to the accepted execution plan submitted by his under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work & also land acquisition problem if any.
Considering the availability of funds, the bill of the Agency will be paid
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable
Relevant documents must be uploaded wherever necessary
If any of the dates mentioned in the Calendar of events happened to be declared holiday, the next working day holds good for event.
Bidder should having Annual Turnover of more than Rs.100.00crores shall submit GST E-Invoice, while claiming the Bills under the above work.
The uploaded drawings are for Tender purpose only
Further information about tendering can be had from www.kppp.Karnataka.gov.in and office of the undersigned during office hours. (08259-284644)
Further corrigendum/modifications/corrections/addendum if any can be had from www.kppp.Karnataka.gov.in
A Copy of Registeration of firm should be uploaded.
All the documents sought under Pre Qualification Criteria are to be uploaded.
GST registration copy
ISO 9001:2015 Certificate
Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate with EPF paid challan for the previous month in which tender is called through e-procurement portal

The bidder should also furnish the list of works on hand with all details such as bid cost, date of entrustment, stipulated date of completion, actual date of completion, completed cost of work, latest status of work etc

The intending bidder should have in last five years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26 satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of work such as Consultancy work for Bridge cum Barrage of value not less than 50% of the estimate value of amount put to tender i.e., Rs.25.00 Lakhs. The Work done certificates obtained from the officer not below rank of Executive Engineer should be uploaded. The work done value of the previous year shall be updated to present price level of 2026-27 at 10% per annum

The annual turnover of intending bidder shall not be less than the amount put to tender i.e., Rs.49.00 Lakhs in any two financial years during the last 5 years i.e, from 2021-22 to 2025-26 (in all Classes of Civil Engineering Consultancy works only). The audit Profit and Loss account certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant duly showing with UDIN i.e (Unique Document Identification Number) along with income tax return filed should be uploaded. The turnover of previous years will be updated to the present value of the year 2026-27 giving weightage of 10% for each previous year turnover value.
GST declaration certificate is mandatory and shall be uploaded in the suggested format ANNEXUR-I
